input.quote: HDI's General Manager (as hereinafter defined), may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect the records of the Company's General Manager reasonably related to the calculation of such payments during the Company's normal business hours.
input.rationale: Section 3.4 already meets our position on notice (30 days), business hours, scope (payment-calculation records only), cost (HDI bears it) and no system access, but there is no frequency limit, so HDI could inspect repeatedly — the fallback requires once per year. We added a once-per-twelve-months cap with a single minimal edit; the absence of an independent-auditor requirement is noted but not flagged.

input.quote: In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a one-way liquidated payment on the Company alone — 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, with no ceiling and payable even on a no-cause exit — while HDI owes nothing if it terminates (4.2(b)). That far exceeds the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees. We capped it at three months' fees as the sole termination amount.

input.rationale: Section 9 contains only mutual corporate-authority representations and the Globix acknowledgement — there is no warranty that HDI's development, hosting and operation of the Site will be performed competently, that the Site will conform to the specifications we approve, or any remedy. The launch deadline in 1.6 is a delivery milestone, not a performance warranty. We inserted a workmanlike/conformance/no-malicious-code warranty with a re-performance, repair or refund remedy; there is no disclaimer to carve out.
